card.statement:
Assume that $\mathscr{F}$ and $\mathscr{G}$ belong to $\mathrm{P}_{{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$. Then $\mathscr{F}\star\mathscr{G}$ also belongs to $\mathrm{P}_{{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$.

To prove this result we will need an auxiliary lemma. Here, for $\lambda,\mu\in X_{*}(T)^{+}$ we set

$\widetilde{\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}}^{\lambda,\mu}_{G}:=q(p^{-1}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}\times\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\mu})).$
card.label: Proposition 6.3

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
